files.app/__init__.py: Application factory. Creates the Flask extensions (SQLAlchemy db, Migrate, LoginManager with login view auth.login, Mail, Moment, Babel); create_app(config_class) builds the Flask app, configures it, initialises the extensions, attaches Elasticsearch (only if ELASTICSEARCH_URL), Redis and an RQ task queue 'microblog-tasks', registers the errors, auth (/auth), main, cli and api (/api) blueprints, and outside debug/testing sets up logging (email to admins on errors via SMTP, or stdout, or a rotating file logs/microblog.log, creating logs/). get_locale picks the best language from the request. Imports models at the end.
files.app/api/__init__.py: Creates the 'api' blueprint and imports its users, errors and tokens modules so their routes register.
files.app/api/auth.py: API authentication with Flask-HTTPAuth: basic auth (username + password checked against the database) and token auth (User.check_token); both error handlers return JSON error responses via error_response.
files.app/api/errors.py: JSON error helpers for the API: error_response builds {'error': standard HTTP status text, optional 'message'} with the status code; bad_request is a 400; a blueprint error handler turns any HTTPException into a JSON error.
files.app/api/tokens.py: API token endpoints: POST /api/tokens (basic auth) issues/returns a token and commits; DELETE /api/tokens (token auth) revokes the current token and commits, returning 204.
files.app/api/users.py: REST API for users (/api/users...): get one user, list users with pagination, list followers / following of a user, create a user (no auth; checks required fields and unique username/email), update your own user (403 otherwise). Most routes need a token.
files.app/auth/__init__.py: Creates the 'auth' blueprint and imports its routes.
files.app/auth/email.py: send_password_reset_email(user): makes a reset token and sends the password reset email (text and HTML templates) to the user via send_email.
files.app/auth/forms.py: Flask-WTF forms for authentication: login, registration (validators reject a username or email already in the database), reset password request, and reset password.
files.app/auth/routes.py: Web authentication pages under /auth: login (checks password, logs in, safe redirect to 'next' only for relative URLs), logout, register (creates a user), reset password request (sends email if the address exists), reset password with a token.
files.app/cli.py: Flask CLI commands on a blueprint: a 'translate' group with init LANG, update and compile, which run pybabel through os.system to manage translation files (and remove messages.pot).
files.app/email.py: Email sending with Flask-Mail: send_email builds a message (text, HTML, attachments) and sends it in a background thread, or synchronously when sync=True; send_async_email sends inside the app context.
files.app/errors/__init__.py: Creates the 'errors' blueprint and imports its handlers.
files.app/errors/handlers.py: App-wide 404 and 500 handlers: return a JSON error when the client prefers JSON, otherwise an HTML error page; the 500 handler rolls back the database session first.
files.app/main/__init__.py: Creates the 'main' blueprint and imports its routes.
files.app/main/forms.py: Flask-WTF forms for the main pages: edit profile (username must stay unique unless unchanged; about me up to 140 chars), an empty form (just a submit button, for follow/unfollow), new post (1-140 chars), search (reads from the query string, CSRF off), and a private message.
files.app/main/routes.py: The main web pages (login required): before every request updates last_seen and sets the search form and locale; home/index (post a message with detected language, see followed posts, paginated), explore (all posts), user profile and popup, edit profile, follow/unfollow, translate (JSON, calls the translation service), search (Elasticsearch through Post.search), send and list private messages (with notifications), export posts (starts a background task), notifications (JSON since a timestamp).
files.app/models.py: SQLAlchemy models: User (password hashing, gravatar avatar, follow/unfollow, followed posts, JWT password-reset tokens, API tokens, messages, notifications, background tasks, to_dict/from_dict for the API), Post (searchable by its body), Message, Notification (JSON payload), Task (RQ job id, progress). Also SearchableMixin (keeps the Elasticsearch index in step with database commits, search, reindex), PaginatedAPIMixin (paginated API collections with links), the followers association table, and the Flask-Login user loader.
files.app/search.py: Elasticsearch helpers: add a model's searchable fields to an index, remove a document, and run a multi-field query returning ids and total. Each does nothing (or returns nothing found) when Elasticsearch is not configured.
files.app/tasks.py: Background job code run by an RQ worker: creates its own app and context at import; export_posts(user_id) collects a user's posts (sleeping 5 s per post), updating progress in the job and as a notification, then emails the posts as a JSON attachment; _set_task_progress updates job meta, the notification and marks the task complete at 100.
files.app/translate.py: translate(text, source, dest): calls the Microsoft Translator HTTP API with the configured key; returns an error message if no key is set or the call fails, else the translated text.
files.config.py: Configuration class read from environment variables (with a .env file loaded): secret key (with a hardcoded fallback), database URL (fixing postgres:// and defaulting to SQLite app.db), mail server settings, admin emails, languages, translator key, Elasticsearch URL, Redis URL, posts per page.
files.microblog.py: Entry point for the flask command: creates the app and registers a shell context with sa, so, db and the models.
files.migrations/env.py: Alembic migration environment (Flask-Migrate): configures the database URL and metadata from the Flask app and runs migrations offline (SQL script) or online (with a connection), skipping empty autogenerated migrations.
files.migrations/versions/2b017edaa91f_add_lan: Migration: add a nullable 'language' column (5 chars) to the post table; downgrade drops it.
files.migrations/versions/37f06a334dbf_new_fie: Migration: add 'about_me' and 'last_seen' columns to the user table; downgrade drops them.
files.migrations/versions/780739b227a7_posts_t: Migration: create the post table with indexes on timestamp and user_id; downgrade drops them.
files.migrations/versions/834b1a697901_user_to: Migration: add API token and token_expiration columns to user with a unique index on token; downgrade removes them.
files.migrations/versions/ae346256b650_followe: Migration: create the followers association table; downgrade drops it.
files.migrations/versions/c81bac34faab_tasks.p: Migration: create the task table with an index on name; downgrade drops it.
files.migrations/versions/d049de007ccf_private: Migration: create the message table with indexes, and add last_message_read_time to user; downgrade reverses both.
files.migrations/versions/e517276bb1c2_users_t: Migration: create the user table with unique indexes on email and username; downgrade drops them.

files.tests.py: unittest tests of the User model with an in-memory SQLite test config: password hashing, avatar URL, follow/unfollow and counts, and the followed-posts query.

functions.app/__init__.py::create_app: Builds and returns the Flask app (factory): loads config, initialises db, migrations, login, mail, moment, babel; Elasticsearch client if configured; Redis connection and RQ queue; registers 5 blueprints (/auth, /api prefixes); outside debug/testing adds error email, stdout or rotating-file logging.
functions.app/api/errors.py::error_response: Builds a JSON error body {'error': standard text for the status code, 'message' if given} and returns it with the status code. No side effects.
functions.app/api/tokens.py::get_token: POST /api/tokens with HTTP basic auth: gets (or creates) the user's API token, commits to the database, returns {'token': ...}.
functions.app/api/tokens.py::revoke_token: DELETE /api/tokens with token auth: expires the current user's token, commits, returns an empty 204 response.
functions.app/api/users.py::get_following: GET /api/users/<id>/following with token auth: 404 if the user does not exist; returns a paginated JSON collection of the users that user follows (page and per_page from the query string, per_page max 100). Reads the database.
functions.app/api/users.py::get_user: GET /api/users/<id> with token auth: returns the user as JSON (to_dict) or 404. Reads the database.
functions.app/api/users.py::update_user: PUT /api/users/<id> with token auth: 403 unless updating yourself; 404 if missing; rejects a username or email already taken (400); updates fields from the JSON body, commits, returns the user as JSON.
functions.app/auth/routes.py::reset_password: GET/POST /auth/reset_password/<token>: redirects logged-in users home; verifies the reset token (JWT) to find the user, else redirects home; on a valid form sets the new password, commits, flashes and redirects to login; otherwise renders the reset form.
functions.app/auth/routes.py::reset_password_reque: GET/POST /auth/reset_password_request: redirects logged-in users; on a valid form looks up the user by email and, if found, sends a password reset email; always flashes the same message and redirects to login; otherwise renders the form.
functions.app/main/routes.py::explore: GET /explore (login required): paginated list of all posts, newest first, rendered with the index template, with next/prev page links. Reads the database.
functions.app/main/routes.py::export_posts: GET /export_posts (login required): if no export task is running for the user, launches a background 'export_posts' task (RQ) and commits; else flashes that one is in progress; redirects to the user's profile.
functions.app/main/routes.py::follow: POST /follow/<username> (login required): with a valid (CSRF) form, finds the user; flashes and redirects if missing or yourself; otherwise follows them, commits, flashes and redirects to their profile. Invalid form redirects home.
functions.app/main/routes.py::search: GET /search (login required): validates the search form (from the query string) or redirects to explore; searches posts through Elasticsearch (Post.search) for the page, renders results with next/prev links.
functions.app/main/routes.py::send_message: GET/POST /send_message/<recipient> (login required): 404 if the recipient does not exist; on a valid form saves a private message, updates the recipient's unread-message notification, commits, flashes, redirects to their profile; else renders the message form.
functions.app/main/routes.py::translate_text: POST /translate (login required): reads text, source and destination language from the JSON body and returns {'text': translation} from the Microsoft Translator call (translate()).
functions.app/main/routes.py::unfollow: POST /unfollow/<username> (login required): like follow but unfollows: validates the form, handles missing user or yourself, unfollows, commits, flashes and redirects.
functions.app/main/routes.py::user: GET /user/<username> (login required): 404 if no such user; renders the profile page with that user's posts paginated newest first and an empty form for follow buttons.
functions.app/main/routes.py::user_popup: GET /user/<username>/popup (login required): 404 if missing; renders the small popup template for the user (with an empty form).
functions.app/models.py::PaginatedAPIMixin.to_coll: Static helper: paginates a query, and returns a dict with 'items' (each item's to_dict), '_meta' (page, per_page, total pages, total items) and '_links' (self, next, prev URLs via url_for). Reads the database.
functions.app/models.py::User.is_following: Returns True if this user follows the given user: queries the following relationship for that user's id. Reads the database.
